webRestore.instruction: Restore approved opening; self-review then publish. Allow a compressed web derivative, preserve original, no new film or paid service. On demand, skippable, no entry blocking; honor mute/gesture and stop on leave/background.
webRestore.recipe: Two-pass FFmpeg: -vf scale=540:960:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -refs 6 -b:v 570k -maxrate 2000k -bufsize 4000k -qcomp 0.7 -profile:v high -level:v 3.1 -pix_fmt yuv420p; pass 1 -an -f null; pass 2 -c:a aac -b:a 80k -ac 2 -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart -map_metadata -1
webRestore.trigger: manual Watch only; no startup or idle video request
webRestore.publicSelection: web derivative and poster only; retain all originals outside public build
webRestore.qualityReview: Replaces the 600k-VBV first candidate after full-frame comparison revealed block artifacts in fast battle motion. Two-pass allocation and wider VBV prioritize difficult frames without increasing the total budget.
